attributes.board_name: Ohio Speech and Hearing Professionals Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Hours must be earned in the current practice biennium (Jan 1 of the odd year to Dec 31 of the even year); 60 minutes = 1 CE hour. Hours are tracked in three subject areas: clinical, ethics and related. CE approved in related disciplines by an Ohio or other state licensure board may be accepted for ethics.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest on the eLicense renewal; after the Dec 31 deadline randomly selected licensees must show proof in CE Broker (the Board's official CE tracking system). Keep proof for four years. A failed audit or hours completed after the deadline lead to a $120 late fee.

topics.who: All licensees, every biennium; course title must show ethics or a course description is needed

rules.notes: Of the 20 hours: at least 10 clinical, at least 2 ethics, the rest (up to 8) related or clinical, as listed on the Board's CE audit page. Licenses expire Dec 31 of even years (current cycle 2025-2026, expiring Dec 31, 2026). Human trafficking courses may count voluntarily. The rule text on codes.ohio.gov could not be opened from our location; numbers taken from the Board's own CE pages.
rules.rule_quote: (A) A licensee shall earn twenty continuing education hours within the two-year licensure period immediately preceding the licensee's renewal application.
